# Reviewed AW migration fixture

Exact copies of `skills/aw-init/scripts/migrate-skills.py`,
`skills/aw-init/scripts/bundled-skill-fingerprints.json`, and
`skills/aw-init/scripts/upgrade-config.rb` from
https://github.com/antonyjclements/augmented-workflow/tree/3fd4c3f6d731b506d969b56b1c086782cc699748.

These fixtures exercise the real upstream migration contract, not a mock or a
second implementation. Do not edit them independently of the upstream review.
